candidates.protected_reason: Germ cell tumors are rare in this location and may be missed in favor of more common cardiac or mediastinal pathologies, highlighting the need for a broad differential diagnosis.

candidates.name: Thymoma
support_spans: a 6.3 cm×4.5 cm×5.5 cm cystic mass above the left atrium
candidates.why: Thymomas can present as anterior mediastinal masses and, although less likely to be cystic, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of a mass in this location, especially with associated systemic symptoms.
candidates.protected_reason: Thymomas are often overlooked in favor of more common causes of chest pain and dyspnea, but they can have significant implications for treatment and prognosis, particularly if associated with myasthenia gravis or other paraneoplastic syndromes.
